title: deps(v18): move objectui's @objectstack/* from 18.0.0-next.1 to 18.0.0-next.2 and follow its contract — the bump objectui#12406, #12592, #12486 and #12285 wait on
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer directed.** objectui#12030's ruling (the maintainer, 2026-10-09: 「让 objectui 提前改用 next 预发布版」) keeps objectui on the `next` prereleases. objectui#12370 carried `18.0.0-next.1` the same way. `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.2` was published to `next` at 2026-10-16T03:11Z, built from objectstack `e5136ff10f`. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (seat post #9771, `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`) as the one bump card for this release, because none exists. ⛔ Not a claim; grade and lane are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat, in one PR, on the path objectui#12370 took. The publish itself is not objectui's.

## Why now

objectui `main` (`63d00da3d`) still resolves `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.1` in `pnpm-lock.yaml`, with ranges at `^18.0.0-next.1`. Triage has already unlocked four cards against `next.2`, but none can land green until the lockfile moves:

| card | grade | how it rides |
|:--|:--|:--|
| objectui#12592 | p2 | **in this PR.** Its own body says the interim exit pin `AppContent.recordDialogInterimBound-12521.test.tsx` turns red on this bump and names its deletion, so the bump cannot land green without it. |
| objectui#12406 | p1 | after the bump. Its `Restart-when:` asks for the lockfile itself to resolve a release past `next.1` whose `AdminScope` refuses the two keys. |
| objectui#12486 | p2 | after the bump. It drops the page renderer's retired `'jsx'` arm. |
| objectui#12285 | p3 | after the bump. Its `Restart-when:` also requires that objectui resolves the release. |

objectui#12627 (`showStar`) lands **before** the bump: triage reads that objectstack PR #23781 is not in `next.2`.

## What the bump measures

- **Upstream range:** objectstack `0c52e43075..e5136ff10f` (the `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.1` and `@18.0.0-next.2` tags). It holds 187 commits, 39 of them `!:` (breaking).
- The dev measures which of them reach objectui, as objectui#12370's held-card table did: against the `next.2` tarball, with `next.1` as the negative control.
- The lockfile moves via `pnpm`, never by hand. Range floors move only where a held card needs them.

## Acceptance

- The PR's CI runs against the installed `18.0.0-next.2`, and every check is green.
- objectui#12592's changes are in the same PR.
- Each held card above is restarted by the unlock scan when this merges.

Dedupe (REST search, objectui, open and closed: "spec bump next.2", "deps v18 18.0.0-next.2"): no match. The nearest is objectui#12370, the closed `next.1` bump.
